answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fakes. Each agent locks a 200 POA bond, then replays its behavior fingerprint of timing, task mix and counterparties over 20 epochs, checked through a prism of history splitting real from cloned. To forge 20 epochs of history per fake plus a walnut-sized puzzle at 5 POA each, 1,000 fakes cost 200,000 POA bonds and 5,000 POA puzzles against a 12,000 POA pool; honest agents pay once and keep their full share.
